purpose: Held-out-family split (E1 in techniques/10 on PR #92). Tags every Decision Index public benchmark by how much our TRAINING data covers it, so every candidate reports in-domain and new-domain-proxy scores separately. The 0.3 Full score is 30% private 'decision tasks from new domains'; the benchmarks tagged 'none' are our local, public stand-in for that part. They are a proxy only: the private new-domain set is unpublished and we do not know its families.
training_set: m2 150k mix: data/manifests/sample-150000-seed20261006.pointer.json (records sha256 82fb395d...a166); sources in data/SOURCES.md and receipts/2026-10-06-D-m2-data-150k/README.md

tiers.same_source: training uses a train split of this benchmark's own upstream dataset
tiers.same_family: no train split of this dataset, but a training source has the same task family (same decision type and skill; different source)
tiers.none: no training source shares the dataset or the task family -> NEW-DOMAIN PROXY

rule: A benchmark's tier is the strongest coverage any training source gives it. Families are assigned by task (what decision is made over what input), not by area. Changing the training mix (e.g. E6 generator data for CRUXEval/CLadder) moves benchmarks out of 'none'; that requires a new families-vN file, and results must name the version they were computed under.
